remarks: Immaculate First Floor office/retail space in one of the city's most unique Class A Buildings, beaming with many modern upgrades and crisp modern design, newly installed kitchenette with hooked in dishwasher and microwave, ADA compliant features, and outdoor deck space with spectacular views of Holts Ice Pond. The space is already subdivided and ready for office use but welcomed to bring your touch and transform the space to fit your needs. Additionally, the building is conveniently located with close proximity to the nearest highway for easy find and accessibility and offers plenty of parking for your comfort!
